OURS · numbers from the verifier reports

segments.say: On January 1st, 2027, California bans food with Red No. 3. Stores get one overnight shift to clear it, even when it hides as erythrosine or E127.
segments.beat: One night to clear the shelves

segments.say: Gemini 4 Argon holds the whole system in one continued generation: 646,825 tokens of code, and after a one-line fix, every one of its 6,581 cross-file links lines up.
segments.beat: The whole system in one generation

segments.say: In that run, our verifier found 21,459 plan mistakes, mostly one associate sent to two shelves at once, or outside their shift. A managed agent fixed the root cause: scheduling mistakes went to zero, even in 10 stores it never saw.
The working core, on 20 stores, found all 467 products with Red No. 3 and pulled none of the 483 look-alikes.
Argon writes the whole thing at once, the verifier proves it, the agent repairs it. Simulated drill; every number from the verifier.
